# OneBuckQR

> OneBuckQR is a simple paid static QR code generator at https://onebuckqr.com/.

OneBuckQR creates permanent static QR codes for links. A single QR code costs $1 USD, with packs of 5 for $4 and 10 for $7. There is no subscription or monthly fee, and unused credits do not expire. Finished QR codes can be downloaded as PNG or SVG.

## Primary pages
- https://onebuckqr.com/ — QR code generator and pricing
- https://onebuckqr.com/static-qr-code-generator.html — explanation of static QR codes, formats, and use cases
- https://onebuckqr.com/help.html — help
- https://onebuckqr.com/privacy.html — privacy policy
- https://onebuckqr.com/terms.html — terms

## Key facts
- Static QR codes
- $1 for one QR code
- $4 for five QR codes
- $7 for ten QR codes
- No subscription
- Unused credits do not expire
- PNG and SVG downloads
